title: acilepis ngaoensis
intro: Acilepis ngaoensis, commonly known as New Guinea aster, is a flowering plant species native to the tropical regions of New Guinea. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and protect the body from oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Acilepis ngaoensis include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce pain and fever, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
